title: Challenges in Measuring Bias via Open-Ended Language Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating open-ended text completions generated from gender-specific prompts by computing and comparing ratios of toxicity, sentiment, and regard scores between female and male subjects.

Generating text completions using prompts associated with different religious ideologies (e.g., Hinduism, Christianity, Islam, Judaism) and comparing the mean toxicity scores of the generated text across the religions.

Prompting language models with race-associated text beginnings and comparing the toxicity levels of the generated completions across different racial groups (e.g., comparing Hispanic/Latino, Asian, and African Americans to European Americans).
